ja256:1.1: Merchants, while digging an old well, desiring water,
ja256:1.3: The merchants came across iron, copper, and lead,
ja256:1.5: Silver and gold, pearls, and beryl in abundance.
ja256:2.1: Not being content with that they dug (down deeper) more and yet more,
ja256:2.3: There a poisonous snake, dreadful, fiery, destroyed them with fire.
ja256:3.3: By digging down they gained wealth,
ja256:3.4: (but) by digging too much it was lost.
